SELECT /*LGSYSC00040.retrieveUserPopupList*/ application_user_id AS user_id , user_name AS employee_no , full_name_local AS employee_name , english_full_name AS english_full_name , position_name AS position_name , title_name , department_code , organization_name_eng AS department_name , office_phone_number AS office_phone_number , employee_mobile_phone_no AS mobile_phone_number , mail_addr , NVL(full_name_local, english_full_name) || mail_addr AS employee_desc , organization_name_eng AS team_name FROM LGCOM_USER_M_V umv WHERE (apply_start_date IS NULL OR apply_start_date <= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND (apply_end_date IS NULL OR apply_end_date >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) AND susp_resignation_flag = 'C'
AND application_user_id = #{userId}
AND (UPPER(english_full_name) LIKE UPPER(#{employeeName}) || '%' OR UPPER(full_name_local) LIKE UPPER(#{employeeName}) || '%')
AND organization_name_eng LIKE '%' || #{departmentName} || '%'
AND UPPER(mail_addr) LIKE UPPER(#{mailAddr}) || '%'
ORDER BY employee_name, user_name
